title: “She Speaks in Tongues But Can’t Submit — The Religious Spirit in Marriage”
paragraphs: “She Speaks in Tongues But Can’t Submit — The Religious Spirit in Marriage”

She leads women’s prayer meetings. She posts verses daily. She corrects others online about modesty and end times.
But at home, she resents her husband. Disrespects him. Interrupts. Controls.
She’s more submitted to her favorite preacher than to the man God gave her.
⚠️ She’s not empowered — she’s in rebellion. And she’s calling it spiritual.

❓ READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
“Brother John, I thought submission was outdated or even abusive. Isn’t a Christian wife free in Christ?”
📖 MAIN VERSE — Ephesians 5:22–24 (KJV):

“Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church…
Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.”

🚨 THIS SCROLL WILL REVEAL:
✔️ The difference between godly submission and spiritual manipulation
✔️ How Satan uses religion to justify pride in wives
✔️ Why a loud “Christian” woman can still be out of order with God
THE CORE TRUTH — Submission Is Not Optional, It’s Order
📖 KEY SCRIPTURE — Colossians 3:18 (KJV):
“Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.”
🧬 GREEK BREAKDOWN — “Submit”
Submit = ὑποτάσσω (hupotassō)

➤ Literally: “To arrange under,” “to bring under authority,” “to willingly yield one's own will under another”
➤ A military term implying strategic alignment under rank — not inferiority, but order.

📛 This is not cultural. It is covenantal.
A wife who refuses to submit breaks divine alignment, even if she prays 10 hours a day.
🧬 HEBREW SHADOW — Proverbs 21:9 (KJV):
“It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.”
Brawling = madōn — meaning contentious, argumentative, quarrelsome.

💥 A “brawling” woman isn’t always yelling — sometimes, she hides it behind “spiritual concerns” or “discernment.”
Yet she resists her husband’s leadership in the name of “God told me.”
🔥 CORE TRUTH:

A Christian wife who refuses to submit is not just being strong — she is being spiritually deceptive.
She may pray, preach, and serve — but she is out of divine rank, and God will not anoint disorder.
📛 You cannot claim to be submitted to Jesus while rejecting the one He appointed over you.

BIBLICAL & HISTORICAL PROOF — THE ORDER OF GOD IS NOT OPTIONAL
📖 BIBLICAL PROOF — SCRIPTURE REVEALS THE DIVINE ORDER
📖 1 Peter 3:1–2 (KJV):

“Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.”
💡 Even if the husband isn’t walking fully with God — submission remains the weapon of transformation.
📖 Ephesians 5:33 (KJV):
“…and the wife see that she reverence her husband.”
💡 Reverence = respect, honor, deferential trust — not public correction, sarcasm, or spiritual superiority.
📖 Titus 2:4–5 (KJV):

“That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands…
To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands,
that the word of God be not blasphemed.”
⚠️ To ignore this order is not just a personal issue — it brings dishonor to God’s name. It blasphemes His Word.
🧱 HISTORICAL PROOF — EARLY CHURCH FATHERS ON MARRIAGE ORDER
✍️ Tertullian (c. 200 AD)
“How pleasing is a marriage between two believers!… She who obeys her husband obeys God.”
🔗 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0402.htm
✍️ John Chrysostom (c. 400 AD)
“The wife is a second authority in the home, not the first. When she honors her husband, she honors the King who placed him there.”
🔗 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/2309.htm
✍️ Clement of Alexandria (c. 190 AD)
“A woman who rules her husband usurps the place of God’s design and invites destruction into her house.”
🔗 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0211.htm

💥 EARLY CHURCH = Unanimous
A godly woman is submitted in posture, words, and tone — not just “technically obedient.”

📛 Submission is not silence. It is not weakness.
It is spiritual rank that invites glory or judgment.
OLD TESTAMENT PROPHETIC CONNECTIONS
🧱 God's order for the home was not invented by Paul — it was echoed through the prophets and reinforced from Genesis.
📖 Genesis 2:18 (KJV):
“And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.”
💡 The wife was created as a helper, not a controller. Equal in value, distinct in assignment.
📖 Proverbs 12:4 (KJV):
“A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.”

💥 A virtuous wife exalts her husband.
A rebellious one destroys him from the inside out.
📖 Proverbs 14:1 (KJV):
“Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.”
💡 Not every wife tears her house down with sin — some do it with spiritual pride.
📖 Esther 1:20 (KJV):
“…all the wives shall give to their husbands honour, both to great and small.”
⚠️ When Queen Vashti refused the king’s command (Esther 1), it caused national disorder — and she was removed.
📛 Rebellion in the home is not just personal — it invites divine replacement.
REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY — “I Was a ‘Godly’ Wife — Until God Showed Me I Was Jezebel”
🧾 TRUE-TO-LIFE TESTIMONY (spirit-forged from multiple cases):
“Everyone thought I was the ideal Christian wife. I prayed over my husband. I posted Scriptures. I led Bible studies. But deep down… I resented him.
I corrected him in public. I rolled my eyes in private. I withheld respect unless I got my way. And I always thought, ‘He’s the one who needs to grow spiritually.’

But one night during prayer, the Holy Spirit spoke directly:
‘You call him weak — but you are in rebellion. You love control more than you love Me.’
I wept. I repented. I saw how I had weaponized religion. I wasn’t submissive — I was spiritual and self-governed.
That night I surrendered. I told my husband, ‘I’ve dishonored you in God’s name. Please forgive me.’

Since then, our home has shifted. God’s peace returned. His confidence returned.
I didn’t lose my power — I finally walked in His order. And His glory came with it.”
🛑 You can’t cast out demons if you’re hosting pride. You can’t call yourself spiritual if you mock your husband’s headship.
FINAL CHALLENGE — WIFE, WILL YOU SURRENDER OR CONTINUE THE SILENT REBELLION?
📖 Acts 5:29 (KJV):
“Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.”

📛 Many wives twist this verse to justify resisting their husbands.
But rebellion in the name of “obeying God” is still rebellion when God says: “Submit to your husband.”
🔥 GOD IS ASKING:

✔️ Will you stop using prayer as a shield for pride?
✔️ Will you stop hiding behind “discernment” when it’s really disrespect?
✔️ Will you rebuild your marriage with humility — not hollow spirituality?
📖 1 Samuel 15:23 (KJV):
“For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry…”
🛑 You’re not “strong-willed.” You’re in witchcraft if your spiritual life is weaponized against your husband’s God-ordained role.
🔥 THIS IS YOUR CHOICE NOW:

✔️ Submit and realign — and see God restore your house
❌ Or continue to serve in church while your home remains under silent judgment
FOOL’S RESPONSE VS. WISE RESPONSE
📖 Proverbs 1:7 (KJV):
“The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.”
🪓 THE FOOLISH WIFE SAYS:

❌ “He doesn’t deserve my respect.”
❌ “I’m the spiritual leader in this house.”
❌ “He should listen to ME more.”
❌ “God speaks to me directly — I don’t need a man’s covering.”
❌ “Submission is oppressive. That’s Old Testament thinking.”
💥 The fool justifies disorder with spiritual excuses. Her pride speaks louder than her prayers.
👑 THE WISE WIFE SAYS:

✅ “Submission is strength — not silence.”
✅ “I will follow God’s design, even if it offends my emotions.”
✅ “My spiritual gifts don’t override God’s order.”
✅ “If I honor my husband, I honor Christ.”
✅ “I would rather walk in heaven’s structure than hell’s rebellion.”
📛 The wise woman doesn’t fight to be seen. She fights to be in alignment.
🧬 ORDER IS POWER. REBELLION IS ROT.

WHICH ONE ARE YOU?
Heaven is watching. So is hell.
WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT?
⏳ Wife of God, answer this with trembling:
If you stood before Jesus tonight, and He asked…

“Did you honor the husband I gave you?”
“Did you submit to My order, or just use My name?”

Would you say…
✔️ “Yes, Lord. I humbled myself and submitted as unto You.”
❌ Or would you say, “But he wasn’t worthy of submission,” only to hear:
📖 Luke 6:46 (KJV):
“And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?”
📖 Hebrews 9:27 (KJV):
“And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment.”

🔥 RELIGION WITHOUT SUBMISSION IS REBELLION IN DISGUISE
You won’t be judged by your church attendance or Bible quotes — you’ll be judged by whether your life lined up with His order.
💥 Your death won’t ask how “spiritual” you were — it will ask if you obeyed.
📛 You don’t have time to fake holiness. Submit now — or face the judgment throne uncovered.
SATAN’S SNEAK ATTACKS — THE RELIGIOUS SPIRIT THAT DESTROYS MARRIAGES
🧠 Satan doesn’t need the wife to sin outwardly — he just needs her to call pride “prayer” and rebellion “revelation.”
👿 SNEAK ATTACK 1: “You’re more spiritual than him”

Whispered in her ear after a prayer session:
“You hear God better. You lead better. You discern more. Why submit?”
💥 Truth: God never uses spiritual gifts to cancel His structure. The Spirit never contradicts the Scriptures.
👿 SNEAK ATTACK 2: “Submission equals weakness”

She watches TV, listens to culture, and slowly believes:
“I’m not being dominated. I’m being empowered.”
💥 Truth: Jesus was fully God — and He submitted to the Father. Submission is power under order.
👿 SNEAK ATTACK 3: “Correct him publicly — it’s bold”

She interrupts, mocks, or contradicts her husband in front of others…
and calls it “clarifying truth.”
💥 Truth: Public dishonor is not clarity — it’s spiritual pride.
📖 James 3:15 (KJV):
“This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.”
⚠️ There is a “wisdom” that sounds bold… but it’s straight from hell.
GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION — WIFE, THIS IS YOUR ALTAR
⚔️🔥 REPEAT THIS OUT LOUD — WITHOUT PRIDE, WITHOUT DELAY 🔥⚔️

“Lord Jesus, I lay down the religious spirit that masked my rebellion.
I renounce pride, control, sarcasm, and every lie that made me exalt my voice over my husband’s covering.

I repent for every time I disrespected, resisted, or spiritually bypassed Your order.
I don’t want to be a public intercessor but a private rebel.

I submit to Your structure. I submit to the man You placed as head.
I will pray, not manipulate. I will honor, not humiliate.

I choose the posture of Christ — not Jezebel.
I will build my house with submission, not tear it down with religion.
Jesus, You are my Lord — and I now walk in Your order.

I AM A GOSPEL WARRIOR WIFE — and I serve with humility, not hype.
In Your name, and for Your glory… AMEN.”
